definition: the devotional side I once had, and lost the live read of around twenty

settled:
The feeling ran before about twenty and never accrued: the door to recall was already shut, so it fired and could not be read back.

I think my faith has always depended primarily on the conceptual side. Even when I could feel, I still could not remember feeling.

What closed was the live read, not the memory of it. The memory was never there to lose.

I put the closing at about the time my nervous system broke on my mission, right before twenty, and I hold that link lightly.

The notes I kept from then record that the feeling was strong, and nothing else.

I am waiting for my safety to recover far enough that the feeling recurs, so that I can finally read what it is.

I value emotions and understanding emotions even if they are ephemeral. My identity is itself ephemeral, so for the Alans that get to feel, feeling is a wonderful thing.

Growing up in the church is the one stretch where I suspect my own memory of running to the vivid.
